units.source_text: 那时候，我心中产生了一股异样的冲动。

en.t: At that moment, a strange impulse arose in my heart.

units.source_text: 犹如重要的话要脱口而出却被给巴所阻碍时一样，

en.t: It was like when important words are about to burst from one's mouth but are blocked by a stammer,

units.source_text: 这股冲动就在我的喉咙里燃烧。

en.t: and that impulse burned in my throat.

units.source_text: 过去母亲暗示过的让我继承住持之职的希望是愚蠢的。

en.t: The hope my mother had once hinted at, that I would inherit the position of temple abbot, was foolish.

units.source_text: 这时候我连升大学的希望也渺然了。

en.t: By then, even my hope of going on to university had grown faint.

units.source_text: 我渴望从对我无言的支配。

en.t: I longed to escape from the silent domination over me,

units.source_text: 无言的压迫中逃脱出来。

en.t: to break free from that silent oppression.
